description: 국토교통부_(TAGO)_지하철정보 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 지하철역목록, 역별출구목록, 출구별버스노선목록, 역별시간표목록을 조회하는 지하철정보 서비스이며, 지하철 정보는 키워드 기반 지하철역 목록조회, 지하철 역 출구별 버스노선 목록, 지하철역. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 지하철, 지하철정보, 지하철노선, 지하철 운행, 지하철 시간표. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-03-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
